source.text_original: 垃圾游戏！
Trash game!
肯太强了，赶紧削！
Ken is too strong, nerf him now!

segments.quote: Ken is too strong, nerf him now!

source.text_original: 不要削弱肯。
Do not nerf Ken.
他说“肯垃圾”，但我反对。
He said "Ken is trash", but I disagree.

segments.quote: He said "Ken is trash", but I disagree.

source.text_original: 肯可真是“平衡”啊。
Ken is so "balanced".
我也是。
Me too.
请降低隆的波动拳伤害；但保持隆的升龙拳无敌。

但保持隆的升龙拳无敌。
